input.why: Their leading binding for the Y button across other games (14 of 35 profiles, 40%), e.g. 007 - First Light, well ahead of the next option (17%). The specific job Y did in those games isn't confirmed to be jump.
Their leading binding for X across other games (13 of 34, 38%), e.g. ARC Raiders, ahead of the next option (12%).
Their leading binding for B (14 of 37, 38%), e.g. ARC Raiders, ahead of the next option (14%).
Their leading binding for left_trigger (19 of 41, 46%), e.g. ARC Raiders, well ahead of the next option (27%).
Their leading binding for left_bumper (15 of 39, 38%), e.g. Apex, well ahead of the next option (18%).
Their leading binding for left_joy_up (20 of 43, 47%), e.g. 007 - First Light, ahead of tilting the stick itself up (35%).
Their leading binding for left_joy_down (21 of 43, 49%), e.g. 007 - First Light, ahead of tilting the stick itself down (33%).
Their leading binding for dpad_N (12 of 28, 43%), e.g. Apex, well ahead of the next option (11%).
Their leading binding for dpad_S (8 of 30, 27%), e.g. Call of Duty Black Ops 6, ahead of the next options (10% each).
Their leading binding for dpad_E (12 of 33, 36%), e.g. ARC Raiders, well ahead of the next option (12%).
Their leading binding for start (13 of 33, 39%), e.g. 007 - First Light, ahead of the same input with a delay (24%). Start is conventionally Pause, though Celeste's own docs don't spell that out.

The only binding they have ever used for guide, consistent across all 3 of their profiles that include it, e.g. Eurotruck Simulator 2. Guide is a system-level button so the job is the same regardless of game.
Their leading binding for the A key (50 of 123 profiles, 41%), e.g. Apex, well ahead of the next option (27%). Celeste's own use of this key isn't documented.
Their leading binding for the C key (50 of 122, 41%), e.g. 007 - First Light, well ahead of the next option (25%). Celeste's own use of this key isn't documented.
Overwhelming leading binding for the F1 key (59 of 124, 48%), e.g. A Plague Tale 1+2, well ahead of the next option (31%). Celeste's own use of this key isn't documented.
Their leading binding for the H key (39 of 98, 40%), e.g. A Plague Tale 1+2, well ahead of the next option (22%). Celeste's own use of this key isn't documented.

input.question: Grabbing and climbing walls can go on the right trigger. In your other games you've split almost evenly between a center puff and tilting the joystick up itself - which do you want here?

options.label: Center puff, as in 007 - First Light and several other games (27% of the time)
Tilt the joystick up, as in Construction Simulator and several other games (27% of the time)
Soft center puff, as in Battlefield 2042 (20% of the time)

input.question: Grabbing and climbing walls can also go on the right bumper. Your history here is fairly split - which input do you want?

options.label: Right sip with a short delay, as in Apex (26% of the time)
Soft center sip, as in Battlefield 6 (21% of the time)
Right-center puff, as in the Default Shooter profile (13% of the time)

input.question: Moving left and aiming a dash to the left can go here. Your history is split fairly evenly between a few different inputs - which do you want?

options.label: Left sip with a delay, as in a Call of Duty Black Ops 6 profile (13% of the time)
The W input, as in Eurotruck Simulator 2 (13% of the time)
Left puff with a short delay, as in another Call of Duty Black Ops 6 profile (10% of the time)

input.question: Celeste doesn't document a use for the Back button, and your history for it is fairly split. Do you want it bound to something, or left alone?

options.label: Soft right sip held, as in Battlefield 6 (22% of the time)
Soft right puff with a delay, as in Apex (16% of the time)
Leave it unbound

options.label: Leave it unbound
